nodes.description: Public balance mapping of the StandardToken contract; mutated in transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested allowance mapping; decremented on approved transferFrom and set in approve/constructor.
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Private owner address used by delegate and batchSend access checks; excluded from the ensure modifier allowlist.
Constant Uniswap router address used in the ensure modifier comparison.
External transfer with ensure modifier; performs unchecked balance/allowance subtractions and additions.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
Owner-gated function executing arbitrary delegatecall with attacker-supplied bytes.
Owner-gated batch transfer; multiplies _value by _tos.length without overflow check and emits half values twice.
Modifier computing the Uniswap pair via pairFor and restricting callers to owner or the pair address.
Pure CREATE2 pair-address derivation with hardcoded factory and init code hash.
Deployer sets owner, mints full supply and grants infinite allowance to the router.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and balance mutations.
Low-level delegatecall on an arbitrary target address supplied by the owner.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value mutation inside transferFrom.
Unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total loop in batchSend.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, validated by ensure.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom, validated by ensure.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, controls unchecked balance/allowance mutations.
Target contract address parameter of delegate used directly in delegatecall.
Arbitrary calldata bytes parameter of delegate forwarded to delegatecall.
Array of recipient addresses whose length drives the unchecked total calculation.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner and the Uniswap pair via the ensure modifier before balance mutation.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary delegatecall.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before transferring balances.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
msg.sender is set as owner and granted infinite allowance in the constructor.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value) which is gated by the ensure modifier.
The ensure modifier gate is applied directly to transferFrom.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair via pairFor and compares it against _from.
totalSupply is assigned from the constructor supply parameter.
The constructor mints the full supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the router address.
delegate passes the caller-supplied target and calldata into a delegatecall unsafe operation.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value subtraction.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for both _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
batchSend computes an unchecked total and subtracts it from balanceOf[msg.sender].
batchSend increments balanceOf[_to] for each recipient in the loop.
The computed batch total directly mutates the balanceOf mapping.
The delegatecall is only reached when msg.sender equals the owner state variable.
_from supplies the source key for balance and allowance lookups in transferFrom.
_to supplies the destination key credited in transferFrom.
_value controls the unchecked subtractions of balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without overflow protection.
Parameter a is the arbitrary target address passed to delegatecall in delegate.
Parameter b is the raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall in delegate.
_tos.length multiplies _value in the unchecked total computation inside batchSend.
The recipients array length is a direct operand of the overflow-prone total multiplication.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only used to key balanceOf/allowance reads and writes inside transferFrom, so it folds into that core function.
Parameter _to is only used to credit balanceOf inside transferFrom, so it folds into that core function.
Parameter _value directly drives the unchecked balanceOf subtraction unsafe operation.
Parameter a is consumed exclusively as the delegatecall target inside delegate.
Parameter b is the raw calldata supplied straight to the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter _tos length is the direct operand of the unchecked total multiplication unsafe operation.
